author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Providence is bringing the free LUV U BETTER Block Party back to PVDFest on Friday, September 18. The event will run from 5 to 10 p.m. at the Providence Rink, giving the city’s annual arts festival an R&B-focused opening-night program.

Launched in 2015, LUV U BETTER features DJ sets moving across different eras of R&B and soul, with dance music and contemporary hip-hop influences. The city included the event in its newly released full festival schedule.

Saturday’s Plaza Stage program will connect local performers with a national headliner. Earl Bright & Elevated Choir is scheduled to perform at 12:40 p.m. and return during Big Freedia’s 8:30 p.m. set. Providence officials described the collaboration as part of PVDFest’s tradition of pairing city artists with visiting acts.

The block party and stage performances are free. Visitors should check the city’s festival information before traveling for any schedule or access changes. The announced lineup gives residents two distinct entry points: a Friday evening dance party and a broader Saturday slate built around live performance in downtown Providence.
dek: The free R&B event returns September 18, followed by a Saturday program featuring Big Freedia and local performers.
headline: PVDFest brings LUV U BETTER block party back to Providence
